soc2_trust_services_mapping.implementation: IBANs (Mod-97), PANs (Luhn), emails, Tax IDs, PostgreSQL DSNs, and bearer/API secrets are replaced bijectively with SYM_* tokens before cloud LLM egress across Rust (apodictic-zero-leak-sanitizer), TypeScript SDK, and Python enclaves.

soc2_trust_services_mapping.criteria: CC7.2 — System Anomaly Monitoring & Continuous Fuzz Testing

soc2_trust_services_mapping.implementation: Deterministic wire-protocol fuzzer + proptest exercises malformed length bombs (>16 MiB), split-TCP fragmentation, corrupted Parse/Bind/Execute packets, invalid UTF-8, and SQL bypasses nightly; --mode observe logs WOULD_BLOCK exposure to WORM WAL and exports printable CFO/CTO HTML audit reports.

soc2_trust_services_mapping.control_title: SHA-256 Immutable Policy IR + Z3 Deadlock Consistency Verification + Dual-Solver Agreement
soc2_trust_services_mapping.implementation: Policy rules compile to typed Policy IR verified deadlock-free by Z3 SMT before activation (defaulting new rules to OBSERVE); native Rust proxy requires both libz3 and pure-Rust OxiZ 0.3.4 to agree before permitting financial mutations.

soc2_trust_services_mapping.control_title: SAVEPOINT Trigger Capture, Single-Use Ed25519 HITL Tokens & SHA-256/RFC 6962 WORM Vault
soc2_trust_services_mapping.implementation: PostgreSQL SAVEPOINT captures hidden PL/pgSQL AFTER UPDATE triggers & ON DELETE CASCADE inside rolled-back subtransactions; Odoo 18-20 mutations run <38ms account.move.reversal; high-value writes park for single-use tx_digest-bound Ed25519 CFO approval delivered via HMAC-SHA256 Slack/Teams webhooks; WORM audit vault chains SHA-256 + RFC 6962 Merkle proofs.

ciso_questionnaire_responses.answer: Customer-hosted air-gapped server-room binary/Docker (static Linux x86_64 & aarch64 musl tarballs with SHA256SUMS + systemd unit, zero outbound internet) or Hybrid Zero-PII gateway.
Zero raw PII egress inside the gateway boundary. IBAN, credit card PAN, emails, Tax IDs, DB DSNs, and bearer/API secrets are bijectively replaced with SYM_* tokens locally before any LLM call.

Solver crash, timeout (>50ms QF_LIA cutoff), libz3 vs. OxiZ divergence, malformed PostgreSQL frames (>16 MiB or invalid length), or missing approval tokens default fail-closed and return SQLSTATE 40001 / 42501 / 28000 / HTTP 403.
Enforced via customer VPC firewall / pg_hba.conf restricting AI agent service credentials strictly to the Apodictic proxy listener (port 5433) with upstream credentials vaulted.

Verified via --savepoint-mode (PostgreSQL) and PGlite 18.7 shadow execution: wraps queries in SAVEPOINT, observes actual trigger/cascade state diffs, and rolls back automatically on invariant breach (32/32 trigger drains caught in live PostgreSQL 17 CI).

High-value writes (>spend cap) park and dispatch Slack/Teams webhooks signed with X-Apodictic-Signature HMAC-SHA256. Approvals require single-use Ed25519 capability tokens cryptographically bound to sha256(canonical_sql|amount) with single-consume jti replay protection.

Addresses Odoo 20 /json/2/ Bearer APIs, enforces advisory bearer_scope='mcp' as hard fail-closed blocking on mutating methods, protects against posted move tamper, and dispatches compensating account.move.reversal entries.
Implemented in safe Rust (apodictic-wire-proxy) with bounded 16 MiB frame checks and tested against 1,000,000 adversarial fuzzed wire frames + 512 proptest cases (0 panics, 0 hostile SQL bypasses).
Every observation and block appends to an hash-chained WORM SQLite/file vault + RFC 6962 binary Merkle inclusion proof log; verified surviving SIGKILL at 4 execution phases.
Defaults new policies and offline installers to --mode observe so teams collect a signed CFO/CTO Shadow Audit Report before toggling --mode enforce.
